title: Law to require help for 600 first-time homebuyers yearly
summary: This bill would require the Department of Housing Preservation and Development to provide downpayment or closing cost assistance to at least 600 first-time homebuyers each year through its HomeFirst program, starting in the fiscal year beginning July 1, 2026. The department would need to publish an annual report by July 31 showing how many buyers were helped, the median assistance amount, and the community districts of homes purchased. If fewer than 600 buyers were assisted in a year, the report must explain why and describe plans to meet the goal.
